text: All 10 tests pass. Let me clean up

All 10 tests pass now. Here are the three bugs I fixed in `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`** — used `set()` which does not preserve insertion order. Changed to an order-preserving approach using a `seen` set + output list.

2. **`partition`** — returned `(no, yes)` instead of `(yes, no)`. Swapped the return tuple to put matches first.

3. **`windows`** — used `range(0, len(items) - k)` which drops the last window. Changed to `len(items) - k + 1` so the final sliding window is included.
